annotations.text:
Overview lens, three data states.
Layout, hierarchy and density only. Palette and type ramp are the frozen sc-kit and do not change.
Drawn against the live Bastrop page, not the August map.

Structural move: Connections DEMOTES to the bottom when the city reads sources and PROMOTES to the top when it does not.
Zero reads as "here is what to connect next" rather than as a broken page.

Right rail keeps the map and the address lookup. The old Sources panel is replaced by ON THE MAP - located records you can click, instead of the atom-type list that leaked engine vocabulary to a city manager.

Tiles are filtered entry points. Each names the lens and filter it opens.
An unread tile says "Not read", never 0.
PINNED, not designed here: the Overview map itself. It renders broken on the live page and needs its own pass after Development services.
